title: dryopteris aculeata subsp. lobata
intro: Dryopteris aculeata subsp. lobata, commonly known as a type of fern, is a plant species that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris aculeata subsp. lobata include its ability to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to the presence of bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant also contribute to its antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable species in traditional medicine.
